newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk raises Conrail bid to $10 bln - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk raises Conrail bid to $10 bln - WSJ.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp has raised its takeover bid for Conrail Inc to $110 a share or a total of $10 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
The raise in its bid follows a move by rival CSX Corp to improve its own bid for the freight railroad company.
The newspaper said Norfolk's bid was a 10-percent raise on its previous bid. The bid is also nearly $17 a share more than the bid made by CSX, it added.
It said Norfolk had not changed the $660 million estimate of merger savings and other benefits from a Norfolk-Conrail combination.
The newspaper said the bid came after a special meeting of the company's board of directors on Thursday.
